artifacts.notes: Normalized transcription, not a facsimile or critical edition. Historical Latin wording is public domain in the United States; portal markup and translations have separate rights. Historical witness: Acta Apostolicae Sedis 18 (1926), pp. 175-179. Uncollated normalized web transcription; source wording and numbering retained apart from the explicitly recorded corrections and apparatus exclusions. The Latin act includes an Italian letter of Cardinal Gasparri dated 5 September 1924, printed with the act on AAS 18 p. 179. The separate Spanish reply beginning p. 180 is absent from the web delivery. Historical asterisk cross-references to that annex are retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: Original historical wording identified in Acta Apostolicae Sedis 18 (1926), pp. 175-179, published by 1930. United States expired-term assessment under 17 U.S.C. 304 and 305; qualifying foreign restoration under 104A(a)(1)(B) receives only the remainder of that term. The preexisting wording remains distinct from modern HTML, creative revision and translations under 103(b). See src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml for the primary authorities and jurisdictional limits. The contemporaneously printed Italian Gasparri annex is also included on its own historical wording basis.
